items.source: To check whether a bean factory contains a bean definition with a given name, use ListableBeanFactory's containsBeanDefinition. Calling both containsBeanDefinition and containsSingleton answers whether a specific bean factory contains a local bean instance with the given name.
items.translation: 要检查 Bean 工厂是否包含具有给定名称的 Bean 定义，请使用 `ListableBeanFactory` 的 `containsBeanDefinition`。同时调用 `containsBeanDefinition` 和 `containsSingleton` 可以回答特定的 Bean 工厂是否包含具有给定名称的本地 Bean 实例。

items.source: The ConfigurableBeanFactory interface extends this interface.
items.translation: `ConfigurableBeanFactory` 接口扩展了此接口。

items.source: The given instance is supposed to be fully initialized; the registry will not perform any initialization callbacks (in particular, it won't call InitializingBean's afterPropertiesSet method). The given instance will not receive any destruction callbacks (like DisposableBean's destroy method) either.
items.translation: 给定的实例应已完全初始化；注册表将不会执行任何初始化回调（特别是，它不会调用 InitializingBean 的afterPropertiesSet方法）。给定的实例也不会接收任何销毁回调（例如 DisposableBean 的destroy方法）。

items.source: The main purpose of this method is to access manually registered singletons (see registerSingleton(String, Object)). Can also be used to access a singleton defined by a bean definition that already been created, in a raw fashion.
items.translation: 此方法的主要目的是访问手动注册的单例（参见 registerSingleton(String, Object)）。也可用于以原始方式访问已通过 bean 定义创建的单例。

items.source: The main purpose of this method is to check manually registered singletons (see registerSingleton(String, Object)). Can also be used to check whether a singleton defined by a bean definition has already been created.
items.translation: 此方法的主要目的是检查手动注册的单例（参见 registerSingleton(String, Object)）。也可用于检查由 Bean 定义定义的 singleton 是否已经创建。

items.source: The main purpose of this method is to check manually registered singletons (see registerSingleton(String, Object)). Can also be used to check which singletons defined by a bean definition have already been created.
items.translation: 此方法的主要目的是检查手动注册的单例（参见 registerSingleton(String, Object)）。也可用于检查由 Bean 定义定义的哪些单例已经创建。

items.source: The main purpose of this method is to check manually registered singletons (see registerSingleton(String, Object)). Can also be used to count the number of singletons defined by a bean definition that have already been created.
items.translation: 此方法的主要目的是检查手动注册的单例（参见 registerSingleton(String, Object)）。也可用于统计由 Bean 定义定义的、且已创建的单例数量。

items.source: When running within a full BeanFactory: Register a bean definition instead of an existing instance if your bean is supposed to receive initialization and/or destruction callbacks.
items.translation: 在完整的 BeanFactory 中运行时：如果您的 Bean 需要接收初始化和/或销毁回调，请注册 Bean 定义而不是现有实例。

items.source: NOTE: This lookup method is not aware of FactoryBean prefixes or aliases. You need to resolve the canonical bean name first before obtaining the singleton instance.
items.translation: 注意：此查找方法不了解 FactoryBean 前缀或别名。在获取单例实例之前，您必须先解析规范化的 Bean 名称。

items.source: Only checks already instantiated singletons; does not return true for singleton bean definitions which have not been instantiated yet.
items.translation: 仅检查已实例化的单例；对于尚未实例化的单例 Bean 定义，不会返回 `true`。

items.source: Use BeanFactory's containsBean for general checks whether the factory knows about a bean with a given name (whether manually registered singleton instance or created by bean definition), also checking ancestor factories.
items.translation: 使用 `BeanFactory` 的 `containsBean` 进行通用检查，以确定工厂是否知道具有给定名称的 Bean（无论是手动注册的单例实例还是由 Bean 定义创建的），同时也检查祖先工厂。

items.source: NOTE: This lookup method is not aware of FactoryBean prefixes or aliases. You need to resolve the canonical bean name first before checking the singleton status.
items.translation: 注意：此查找方法不了解 FactoryBean 前缀或别名。 在检查单例状态之前，您需要先解析规范化的 Bean 名称。

items.source:
Typically invoked during registry configuration, but can also be used
for runtime registration of singletons. As a consequence, a registry
implementation should synchronize singleton access; it will have to do
this anyway if it supports a BeanFactory's lazy initialization of singletons.
items.translation: 通常在注册表配置期间调用，但也可用于单例的运行时注册。因此，注册表实现应同步对单例的访问；如果它支持 BeanFactory 的单例延迟初始化，无论如何都必须执行此操作。

items.source:
Only checks already instantiated singletons; does not return an Object
for singleton bean definitions which have not been instantiated yet.
items.translation: 仅检查已实例化的单例；对于尚未实例化的单例 Bean 定义，不会返回一个 Object。

items.source:
Only checks already instantiated singletons; does not return names
for singleton bean definitions which have not been instantiated yet.
items.translation: 仅检查已实例化的单例；不会返回尚未实例化的单例 Bean 定义的名称。

items.source:
Only checks already instantiated singletons; does not count
singleton bean definitions which have not been instantiated yet.
items.translation: 仅检查已实例化的单例；不会统计尚未被实例化的单例 Bean 定义。

items.source:
as of 6.2, in favor of lenient singleton locking
(with this method returning an arbitrary object to lock on)
items.translation: 自 6.2 版本起，采用宽松的单一实例锁定（通过此方法返回任意对象作为锁）

items.source:
Add a callback to be triggered when the specified singleton becomes available
in the bean registry.
items.translation: 向 Bean 注册表添加一个回调，以便在指定的单例可用时触发。

items.source: Return the singleton mutex used by this registry (for external collaborators).
items.translation: 返回此注册表使用的单例互斥锁（供外部协作方使用）。

items.source: beanName - the name of the bean
items.translation: beanName - 豆子的名称

items.source: singletonObject - the existing singleton object
items.translation: singletonObject - 现有的单例对象

items.source: singletonConsumer - a callback for reacting to the availability of the freshly registered/created singleton instance (intended for follow-up steps before the bean is actively used by other callers, not for modifying the given singleton instance itself)
items.translation: singletonConsumer - 用于响应新注册/创建的单例实例可用性的回调（旨在用于在 Bean 被其他调用者主动使用之前执行的后续步骤，而非用于修改给定的单例实例本身）。

items.source: beanName - the name of the bean to look for
items.translation: beanName - 要查找的 Bean 的名称

items.source: the registered singleton object, or null if none found
items.translation: 已注册的单例对象，或者如果未找到则返回null。

items.source: the list of names as a String array (never null)
items.translation: 作为 String 数组的名称列表（永远不为null）

items.source: the mutex object (never null)
items.translation: 互斥对象（永远不为null）

items.source: if this bean factory contains a singleton instance with the given name
items.translation: 如果该 BeanFactory 包含一个具有给定名称的单例实例

items.source: the number of singleton beans
items.translation: 单例 Bean 的数量

items.source: Check if this registry contains a singleton instance with the given name.
items.translation: 检查此注册表是否包含具有给定名称的单例实例。

items.source: Return the (raw) singleton object registered under the given name.
items.translation: 返回在给定名称下注册的原始单例对象。

items.source: Return the number of singleton beans registered in this registry.
items.translation: 返回此注册表中注册的单例 Bean 的数量。

items.source: Return the names of singleton beans registered in this registry.
items.translation: 返回在此注册表中注册的单例 Bean 的名称。

items.source:
Register the given existing object as singleton in the bean registry,
under the given bean name.
items.translation: 将给定的现有对象注册为单例，在指定的 Bean 名称下。

items.source: Juergen Hoeller
items.translation: Jürgen Hoeller
